# Under a Ton

> UK deals site listing genuine reductions under £100 (in £20, £50 and £100 tiers) from major UK retailers. Every price is checked on the retailer's own website every morning. Visitors buy directly from the retailer; some links are affiliate links.

Last updated: 23 November 2026. Live deals: 43 (10 under £20, 21 £20–£50, 12 £50–£100).

Real deal check: every listed deal is re-checked on the retailer's site at least daily; each deal shows how many times it has been checked since first spotted and whether its price changed. Method: https://underaton.co.uk/how-we-check.html

Editorial rules: a deal is listed only when the retailer itself shows a higher price it actually charged before; no 'worth' values; no unauthorised voucher codes; all posts and pages disclose affiliate links.
